content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"PR-204 is a plan-coverage denial, not an authorization, coding, medical-necessity, or missing-information issue; authorization is already on file and the claim data are valid. Resubmission would not correct the denial, and a medical-necessity appeal would not address a benefit or eligibility exclusion. A specialist must verify coverage on the service date and determine whether the denial is appealable before any patient billing."}
